pages.text: The Construction Core is a specialized component used in devices that place or construct blocks and items in the world. It is essential for automation involving block placement.
Features:$(li)Used in Constructor devices$(li)Enables block placement automation$(li)Required for automated building$(li)Part of advanced automation systems
Usage:$(li)Craft Constructors for automation$(li)Enable automated block placement$(li)Part of automated farming systems$(li)Used in building automation
